   810→
   811→  return outfits

  1261→/**
  1262→ * Validate an enhanced outfit composition

  1266→ * @param items - Array of enhanced mock products in the outfit

  1269→export function validateEnhancedOutfit(
  1270→  items: EnhancedMockProduct[]

  1272→  const issues: string[] = []
  1273→
  1274→  // Check color tone compatibility
  1275→  const colorToneCompatible = areAllColorTonesCompatible(items)
  1276→  if (!colorToneCompatible) {
  1277→    const tones = items.map(i => `${i.name}: ${i.colorTone}`)
  1278→    issues.push(`Incompatible color tones: ${tones.join(', ')}`)
  1279→  }
  1280→
  1281→  // Check formality consistency
  1282→  const formalityConsistent = areAllFormalityLevelsConsistent(items)
  1283→  if (!formalityConsistent) {
  1284→    const levels = items.map(i => `${i.name}: ${i.formalityLevel}`)
  1285→    issues.push(`Inconsistent formality levels (tolerance: ±${FORMALITY_TOLERANCE}): ${levels.join(', ')}`)
  1286→  }
  1287→
  1288→  // Check style tag overlap
  1289→  const styleTagOverlap = hasCommonStyleTag(items)
  1290→  if (!styleTagOverlap) {
  1291→    issues.push('No common style tag across all items')
  1292→  }
  1293→
  1294→  // Check pairing validity
  1295→  let pairingValid = true
  1296→  for (let i = 0; i < items.length; i++) {
  1297→    for (let j = i + 1; j < items.length; j++) {
  1298→      if (!validatePairingCompatibility(items[i], items[j])) {
  1299→        pairingValid = false
  1300→        issues.push(`Pairing incompatibility: ${items[i].name} <-> ${items[j].name}`)
  1301→      }
  1302→    }
  1303→  }
  1304→
  1305→  // Check for duplicate outfit roles (except accessories)
  1306→  const roleCounts = new Map<OutfitRole, number>()
  1307→  for (const item of items) {
  1308→    const count = roleCounts.get(item.outfitRole) || 0
  1309→    roleCounts.set(item.outfitRole, count + 1)
  1310→  }
  1311→
  1312→  for (const [role, count] of roleCounts.entries()) {
  1313→    if (role !== 'accessory' && role !== 'bag' && count > 1) {
  1314→      issues.push(`Duplicate outfit role: ${role} (${count} items)`)
  1315→    }
  1316→  }
  1317→
  1318→  return {

  1320→    issues,
  1321→    colorToneCompatible,
  1322→    formalityConsistent,
  1323→    styleTagOverlap,
  1324→    pairingValid,
  1325→  }
  1326→}
